thread:
Maya (CSM): Hey team — quick recap from today's intro with Lena from Cobalt Retail. TL;DR: they want a low-latency FAQ generator + embeddings for search, timeline = 4 weeks to pilot. Need owners for tech work, enablement, and success criteria. Who's in? :wave:
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can own the tech side. Planning a deep-dive next Wed. Will need their sample docs and expected qps.
Lena (Customer PM): thanks Maya! Confirming pilot scope: FAQ + semantic search, target 1000 queries/day, SLA goal <200ms p50. I'll share dataset and contact list by EOD.
Tom (Account Exec): noted renewal cadence: customer renewal window opens in 11 months — flagging moderate risk if we don't show clear ROI in pilot. I'll coordinate exec engagement. :memo:
Maya (CSM): Action items I tracked: 1) Ravi — tech deep-dive + infra checklist, 2) Maya — run enablement session for their engineers, 3) Kai — provide recommended model/quant profile, 4) Lena — sample docs + stakeholder list. Add to this if I missed anything.
Kai (Product): I'll run quantization and model-suggestion pass by Friday. Quick ask: what max sequence length we should design for? if docs are short (FAQs) we can push for int8 to save cost.
Lena (Customer PM): most of the docs are short (Q/A pairs, ~200 tokens). int8 sounds fine.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Great. Tentative tech deep-dive invite: Wed 10am PT. Sending calendar now. I'll create a minimal runbook and post it here.
onboarding-bot: Welcome guide uploaded: <https://redwood.company/welcome/cobalt-retail/pilot> — includes checklist, calendar links, and support contacts.
Maya (CSM): Proposed success criteria (please +1/-1): a) stable infra with p50 <200ms, b) accuracy on FAQ answers >= 85% on eval set, c) embeddings NDCG > 0.7 for top-5. If we hit these within 4 weeks -> green. If not -> escalate.
Tom (Account Exec): +1 on criteria. Also add cost-per-1000-queries target: <$3 per 1k tokens (customer expects cost visibility).
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll add a technical acceptance test in the runbook: run the eval harness (script below) and attach results to the thread.```
# run locally
python eval_harness.py --model redwood-v1 --dataset cobalt_eval.json --report out/result.json
```
Maya (CSM): Perfect. I'll schedule weekly 30-min check-ins (Mon 9am PT) for the 4-week sprint and capture feedback in the pilot doc. Lena — does that cadence work?
Lena (Customer PM): Monday check-ins work. Thanks everyone — looking forward to Wed's deep-dive. I'll post the stakeholder roster and data link by EOD. :thumbsup:
